affected_boundaries: durable delivery to missing-checkout recovery and rebase action selection

observed_behavior: A delivered worker needing rebase lost its checkout, and the scheduler classified it as an ordinary blocking missing worktree despite a completed managed session and surviving authenticated delivery.
expected_behavior: The scheduler recovers the same delivered worker before rebase while allowing unrelated ready dispatch; integration still requires a new delivery at the rebased revision.
causal_mechanism: The recovery predicate excluded every delivery and every assignment outside ACTIVE, while the informational delivered-checkout diagnostic applied only to merge-ready or later states.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Adjacent lifecycle paths partitioned missing-checkout handling by states that omitted a valid delivered and divergent assignment.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The omitted state receives a global blocking diagnostic, so no recovery or independent action can be selected.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: A missing delivered checkout that still needs rebase must enter recovery only with exact host, binding, branch, delivery, and ancestry proof; rebase requires an available checkout.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Extend the existing recovery predicate to authenticated delivered REBASE_REQUIRED assignments, then skip rebase selection until the checkout exists. Preserve the delivery through recovery and require a new one after rebase.

applicability_conditions: The worker has an authenticated delivery but its revision does not contain the current integration revision.
The managed checkout disappears while the worker session, branch tip, and delivered commit remain verifiable.
known_non_matches: A merge-ready delivered revision can be integrated without restoring its checkout.
An undelivered active worker uses the existing recovery path.
confirmation_evidence: The focused regression failed on absent CAMPAIGN_WORKTREE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED before the fix and passed after it.
The recovered worker remained REBASE_REQUIRED, and its rebased revision stayed outside readyToMerge until a new authenticated delivery.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: delivered rebase worker with a missing checkout recovers before rebase and preserves delivery
